# load packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
```

# load data

## CSV file

```{r}
rainfall <- read_csv("D:/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/Data/RAW/Rainfall_estimation/10_4231_6YK1-CQ13/10_4231_6YK1-CQ13/Uganda/entebbe_climate_cfsr.csv")

```

# Process data

```{r}
# Add variable labels
rainfall <- rainfall %>%
    rename(
        date = date,
        prcpmm = prcpmm,
        tmin_c = tmin_c,
        tmax_c = tmax_c
    )

## Convert date to date format
rainfall$date <- as.Date(data$date, format = "%Y-%m-%d")

# Create filtered datasets
rainfall20 <- rainfall %>% filter(prcpmm > 20, prcpmm <= 40)
rainfall40 <- rainfall %>% filter(prcpmm > 40, prcpmm <= 60)
rainfall60 <- rainfall %>% filter(prcpmm > 60, prcpmm <= 80)
rainfall80 <- rainfall %>% filter(prcpmm > 80, prcpmm <= 100)
rainfall100 <- rainfall %>% filter(prcpmm > 100)
```

# Plot data

```{r}
# Plot
p1 = ggplot(rainfall, aes(x = date, y = prcpmm, color = prcpmm)) +
    geom_line() +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "red") +
    labs(
        title = "Daily Rainfall in Entebbe, Uganda 1979-2020",
        x = "Date",
        y = "Rainfall (mm)"
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 120, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 80, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 60, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 40, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 20, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 160, 20)) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank()
    )

# Create table with counts of rainfall days above specified thresholds
    rainfall_counts <- data.frame(
    Threshold = c("20 mm", "40 mm", "60 mm", "80 mm", "100 mm"),
    Count = c(
        nrow(rainfall20),
        nrow(rainfall40),
        nrow(rainfall60),
        nrow(rainfall80),
        nrow(rainfall100)
    )
)

p2 = ggtexttable(rainfall_counts)

# Combine plot and table
plot <- ggarrange(p1, p2,
ncol = 1, nrow = 2,
heights = c(10,3))

plot

# Save plot
ggsave("D:/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/Plots/Rainfall_Entebbe.png", plot, width = 10, height = 10, units = "in", dpi = 600)
```

### Hourly rainfall data
```{r}
# load the data
shear_rain <- read.csv("D:/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/Data/RAW/Rainfall_estimation/Hourly_kamp/data/shear_rain.csv")

# Create total rainfall variable
shear_rain$Total_rainfall <- apply(shear_rain[, c("ACTogether.HQ", "Makerere", "MengoSS", "RC.ClimateCentre", "RC.Warehouse")], 1, sum)

# set X as a time variable
shear_rain$X <- as.POSIXct(shear_rain$X, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

# Create a line plot of the total rainfall with color based on intensity
p1 = ggplot(shear_rain, aes(x = X, y = Total_rainfall, color = Total_rainfall)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(20, 40, 60, 80, 100), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray", linewidth = 1) +
    labs(title = "Hourly Rainfall in Kampala (April 2019 - March 2020)", x = "Time", y = "Total Rainfall (mm)") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank()) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(shear_rain$Total_rainfall), by = 20)) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red")

# Create a table that shows the total rainfall per category (0-20, 20-40, 40-60, 60-80, 80-100, 100+)

# Create a new variable that categorizes the total rainfall
shear_rain$Rainfall_category <- cut(shear_rain$Total_rainfall, breaks = c(0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, Inf), labels = c("0-20", "20-40", "40-60", "60-80", "80-100", "100+"))

# Create a table that shows the total rainfall per category
p2 = table(shear_rain$Rainfall_category)

p2 <- ggtexttable(data.frame(p2))

# Combine the plot and the table
ggarrange(p1, p2, ncol = 1, nrow = 2, heights = c(10, 3))

```
